provenance.explanation: The developer uploaded the release file from the cz-hit account. We haven't yet checked whether this file matches the public source code.

updates.label: Updates are set to come from windingwind/zotero-plugin-markdown-note on GitHub, which doesn't exist or isn't public: if the owner of "windingwind" published an update there, Zotero would install it
updates.check: The update address is broken (nothing is there), so Zotero can't update it

sourceTransparency.label: Updates are set to come from an address someone else could control

dataSharing.label: Network code only in bundled libraries: cherry-markdown

badges.label: A zotero:// link (a web page can open one) can make it install add-ons without asking you
A zotero:// link can make it run code if you approve a prompt
Works with files on your computer

compatibility.label: Doesn't work with Zotero 10; works with Zotero 9

overall.label: review-details
reasons: Updates are set to come from an address someone else could control
A zotero:// link (a web page can open one) can make it install add-ons without asking you (from zotero-plugin-toolkit)
A zotero:// link can make it run code if you approve a prompt (from zotero-plugin-toolkit)
